reader.requirement: At --std 85 identifier-1 of USE BEFORE REPORTING (optionally qualified by its report-name) must resolve uniquely to a report group (an 01-level report group description entry), and the same report group must not be named by two USE BEFORE REPORTING statements of one Procedure Division (amended by X3.23b-1993: statements of different, e.g. contained, programs' Procedure Divisions may each name it).
reader.edition-search: Read DeclBindUse's REPORTING arm and ReportGroupResolution.Resolve (its EditionContext parameter is used only to report COBOL1920); grepped ReportGroupResolution.cs for Edition/Version/DialectLevel/Has(: only the parameter. VersionConformancePass#VisitUseStatement gates no BEFORE REPORTING shape. The _useReportGroups register is reset per procedure division (CollectMethodDeclaratives) with no edition test.

reader.notes: Every non-report-group operand is refused, an ambiguous name draws COBOL1920, and a repeat of the same group (however qualified) in a second USE of one Procedure Division is refused while two programs' Procedure Divisions may each name a GLOBAL report's group, as the amended text says. An FD GLOBAL alone did not make the report visible to the contained program (p3k_nested); 1985 gives the RD its own GLOBAL clause, so the RD GLOBAL form was the probe.

refuter.evidence: r3a_ws_same_name at --std 85: WORKING-STORAGE '01 DET-A PIC X' and report group '01 DET-A TYPE DE' of R-A; 'USE BEFORE REPORTING DET-A.' (unqualified) compiles clean and runs N=1. The same unqualified name in GENERATE DET-A (r3d) and MOVE "X" TO DET-A (r3e) also compile clean; at --std 2023 r3a also compiles (N=1). r3c (USE BEFORE REPORTING on an RH and on a PF group qualified OF R-A) runs N=2, correct. The reader's own requirement says identifier-1 must 'resolve uniquely to a report group'; 1985 has no context-based disambiguation: 'Identical user-defined names may appear in a source program; however, uniqueness must then be established through qualification for each user-defined name explicitly referenced' (cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1  (4.3.8.1 Qualification)  the text is in the clause'), and a report group's name is data-name-1 of a data description entry (XIII TYPE/report group format, 1985 line 23495 'When data-name-1 represents a report group to be referred to by a GENERATE or a USE statement'). The compiler resolves DET-A by the operand's expected class (report group) across namespaces, while the two-report case (p3d) is refused COBOL1920. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR2  (4.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'. Reading: SR2's own two requirements (a report group; no repeat within one Procedure Division) are met; the under-rejection is of the general uniqueness rule IV.4.3.8.1 and hits every reference to the name (GENERATE, MOVE), the same at --std 2023, so whether it counts against THIS rule rests on reading 'Identifier-1 must reference a report group' as requiring a unique reference.
